title: Verifier + acceptance gate
description:
**Phase 4 of MVP** under `PPY-54055d`.

## Intent

As a publication operator, I want a verifier that scores net editorial quality, so a revision is accepted only when it is actually better and does not add unsupported claims.

## Done when

- Verifier highlights factual changes, deleted claims, duplicated ideas, residual boilerplate.
- Weighted quality score (specificity, clarity, audience fit, voice match, minus redundancy / unsupported claims / factual-change risk).
- `should_accept_revision` (or equivalent): accept only if net improvement ≥ threshold **and** unsupported claims do not increase.
- Detector score is not an input.

## Depends on

Constrained revision pass.

## Gherkin

```gherkin
Feature: Verifier and acceptance gate
  As a publication operator
  I want a quality gate on a proposed revision
  So we keep only net-better copy and never optimize for a detector score

  Scenario: Accept a revision that improves quality without new unsupported claims
    Given an original draft, a proposed revision, a style profile, and diagnostic JSON
    When the verifier runs
    Then it reports factual changes, deleted claims, duplicated ideas, and residual boilerplate
    And it reports a weighted score for specificity, clarity, audience fit, and voice match minus redundancy, unsupported claims, and factual-change risk
    And should_accept_revision is true only if net improvement meets the threshold and unsupported claims did not increase

  Scenario: Reject when unsupported claims increase
    Given a proposed revision that adds an unsupported claim
    When the verifier runs
    Then should_accept_revision is false
    And detector score is not an input to the decision
```
